beats.summary: Michael asks Pam to wait in line for a pretzel while he goes to the bathroom, but Pam suggests he work in his office instead.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I thought that maybe you could wait in line for me while I go to the bathroom. You're an angel.
Pam: Hey, why don't you just go up to your office, get some work done, and I'll just bring you a pretzel.

beats.summary: Dwight tests Ryan with a series of questions and challenges, including wrestling his cousin Mose.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: It is time for your next test. You have planted the beet seed. You have walked the long lonely walk of loneliness.

beats.summary: Michael orders a pretzel with all 18 toppings, called 'The Works'.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Is there anyway that you could do all, all of them?
Pretzel guy: The Works. You got it.

beats.summary: Ryan refuses to wrestle Mose and ends the challenge, calling Dwight a freak.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: No, you're a freak. I'm not doing this anymore. This is over. Goodbye.

beats.summary: Dwight apologizes to Ryan and offers a basket with eggs, bacon, and a whittled item from Mose.
